title: Context Menu
description: The right-click menu, written as a component instead of an accident of the browser.
usage: For dense surfaces — file rows, canvas items, table cells — where actions belong to the thing under the cursor. Always mirror the same actions somewhere visible; a context menu is a shortcut, never the only door. Focus the trigger and press Shift+F10 or the Menu key to open it.
a11y: Right-click, Shift+F10 or the Menu key opens a menu with button menuitems. Up/Down, Home/End and prefix search move focus. Escape and Tab close it; Escape and selection restore the trigger. Pointer placement flips at viewport edges. Null focusout does not dismiss the menu. Window blur dismisses an open menu without moving focus. One shared outside-press listener per script load serves every menu; loading the script twice adds none.
